text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: metering-ingest-high-latency (P1) — KPI=ingest_latency > 120s for 5m. incident link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/MDL12345

pagerduty-bot: Alert routed to oncall: maya (oncall). Escalation policy: SRE -> Eng-Metrics -> Billing.

maya (oncall): I'm on it, paging raj. Can someone confirm customer-facing impact?

raj (sre): looking at consumer lag now. consumer-01 shows backlog ~1.2M messages. offsets not committing. tailing logs:```
consumer-01 | ERROR Commit failed: OffsetOutOfRangeException partition=12
consumer-01 | WARN Processing delay avg=145s, p99=310s
```

maya (oncall): thanks. tagging billing + support for invoice risk triage @emily (billing) @lisa (support)

emily (billing): thx — high-level question: are token counts undercounting or duplicating? invoice run is in 6h, we need decision path.

tony (eng-metrics): early signal shows token-count delta vs expected = -18% on ingestion keyspace X over last 30m. Looks like messages are being skipped during the commit failure window. Query: `SELECT count(*) FROM tokens_ingested WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'` gave 82k vs expected 100k.

lisa (support): we have 2 customers already flagged by monitoring as potentially at risk (acct: acme-inc, acct: mediaworks). Called CS to prep messaging.

maya (oncall): immediate mitigation: kick consumer group, force rebalance, and enable read-retry. Running command now: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --group metering-consumers --reset-offsets --to-earliest --execute` — will post updates.

ops-runbook-bot: Recommended next steps: 1) attempt graceful consumer restart 2) increase consumer replicas 3) switch to fallback ingestion pipeline (if available) 4) inform billing if token delta > 10%

raj (sre): restarted consumer-01 and consumer-02. After restart, offsets resumed committing but backlog still ~300k. p99 latency down to 85s. Patch applied: `consumer.enable.auto.commit=true` had been accidentally disabled in a deploy. Opening PR to revert config.

maya (oncall): good. what's the ingest throughput now?

tony (eng-metrics): throughput ramping. now processing ~7k msgs/s, expected 9k. ETA to catch up ~6-7m assuming no more failures. Token delta shrunk from -18% to -4% in the last 10m.

emily (billing): if we recover fully before invoice cutoff, invoices may be safe; but we need to plan for manual reconciling if some tokens were lost. What is the maximum exposure?

raj (sre): worst-case missing tokens ~40k (from the 18% window). We'll produce a reconciliation export: `SELECT * FROM raw_ingest WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-14T01:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-14T01:30:00Z'` to feed into billing.

lisa (support): flagged affected customers and created template messages. CS lead assigned to standby for any support tickets.

maya (oncall): escalation status: we've acknowledged PD, fixed immediate cause (bad config deployed), restarted consumers, backlog draining. Assigning postmortem owner: raj. Billing action item: emily to evaluate invoice hold / manual adjustment risk.

pagerduty-bot: Alert acknowledged by maya (oncall). Escalation paused.

emily (billing): I'll run the reconciliation once raj provides the export. If delta > 5% for any customer we'll open an invoice-hold and notify finance.

raj (sre): export in progress, dumping to s3: `s3://redwood-metering/exports/2339876543-missing-tokens.csv.gz` ETA 3m. Also capturing consumer and broker logs for postmortem.

ops-runbook-bot: Reminder: for invoice risk incidents, label the incident with `invoice-risk` and attach reconciliation file.

maya (oncall): update for incident channel: mitigation successful, backlog draining, monitoring to confirm full catch-up. Next: run full end-to-end token reconciliation and decide invoice action by +1h.

lisa (support): CS notified customers with initial heads-up: "We're investigating delayed usage reporting; we're prioritizing to avoid billing errors."

tony (eng-metrics): added temporary alert suppression for noisy backlog p95 during recovery window to avoid alert storms.

raj (sre): export complete and uploaded. sample rows look good. pushing to billing queue now. `aws s3 cp /tmp/missing.csv.gz s3://redwood-metering/exports/`

emily (billing): received the file. preliminary checks show acct acme-inc delta = -2.1% (within tolerance). mediaworks delta = -6.8% — taking that for manual review. Opening ticket FIN-7421 to evaluate invoice hold.

maya (oncall): tracking: incident officially downgraded to P2 for follow-up. PD incident will remain open until reconciliation and postmortem.

pagerduty-bot: Incident status set to: acknowledged -> resolved (P1 mitigation achieved) by maya (oncall) at 2339877000.

raj (sre): capturing root cause: a config flip in canary deploy disabled auto-commit for metering consumer group. Action items: 1) revert bad deploy 2) add pre-deploy config linting 3) add canary alert when consumer commit rates drop 4) update runbook. I'll own PRs.

emily (billing): billing action: mediaworks will get manual reconciliation and invoice hold considered; finance notified.

lisa (support): creating follow-up support threads for affected customers with notes from emily/raj.

maya (oncall): handing off to raj for postmortem and to emily for billing follow-up. I'll leave a handoff note in #oncall-handoffs. Good work team. :thumbsup:

raj (sre): will post detailed postmortem in incidents/postmortems with timeline, diff of deploy, and S3 artifacts.

incident-bot: Incident closed in channel. Links: PD MDL12345, Postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/MDL12345-draft

maya (oncall): signing off from this thread at 2339877120.
